# bg_tarn: a mountain lake at golden hour, drawn by the perspective rig.
# Generated by tools/generate_bg_tarn.py, which states the same horizon,
# contact row and feet; its header has the art argument. Model:
# src/render/depth_rig.h; format: src/render/backdrop_set.h.
#
# The horizon is row 200 and the contact row 264, the terrain's surface, so the
# eye height is 64 rows and the factors follow from the feet:
#
#     mountains 202 -> 0.031    dunes      210 -> 0.156
#     ridge     204 -> 0.063    far pines  240 -> 0.625
#     mesas     207 -> 0.109    near pines 252 -> 0.813
#
# The empty stretch between 0.16 and 0.63 is the lake, and the plane's line
# scroll is what carries it: watching the water shear between the far shore and
# the near one is most of the depth in this set.
#
# Vertical strength 0.75, chosen from preview_backdrop flights at 0.5 and 0.75.
# At 0.5 the horizon falls with the camera at half the world's rate, so flying
# to the ceiling shows only sky. At 1.0 the plane magnifies 1 + 164/64 = 3.6x at
# the ceiling (1080p) and the lake's rows smear. 0.75 keeps the lake in the
# bottom third at the ceiling and magnifies it at most 2.9x. TUNING.md carries it.
#
# The ripple is 0.6 cells either way: under one cell, so a water row never
# detaches from the row above it by a whole art pixel, which reads as tearing.
# The clouds drift 0.6 cells/s right to left -- a lap of the 688-cell sky takes
# about nineteen minutes, slow enough to be noticed rather than watched.
#
# The reeds are 1.30 and in front of the player. Above bg1's cap of 1.00, which
# exists for a world-sized layer that does not wrap; every layer here wraps
# (anchor standing). 1.30 rather than more because faster than that a reed is a
# flicker rather than a thing.

size    688 288
anchor  standing
rig     200 264 0.75
ripple  0.6

# file                        how it moves   flags
layer   bg_tarn_11_sky.bmp        factor=0.00    opaque
layer   bg_tarn_10_clouds.bmp     factor=0.01    drift=-0.6
layer   bg_tarn_09_plane.bmp      plane          ripple=212:239
layer   bg_tarn_08_glint.bmp      factor=0.00    on_plane ripple=212:239
layer   bg_tarn_07_mountains.bmp  foot=202
layer   bg_tarn_06_ridge.bmp      foot=204
layer   bg_tarn_05_mesas.bmp      foot=207
layer   bg_tarn_04_dunes.bmp      foot=210
layer   bg_tarn_03_pines_far.bmp  foot=240
layer   bg_tarn_02_pines_near.bmp foot=252
layer   bg_tarn_01_reeds.bmp      factor=1.30    foreground
